questions.ask: Could you please tell me your date of birth?
What are the last four digits of the phone number we have on file for you?

hints.day_month_swapped: Could you please say the month of your birth as a word?

intents.hardship: The customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss.
intents.dispute: "This debt is not mine" or "I never had this product"; a claim that the product was closed or paid off in the past is also a dispute.
intents.already_paid: "I already paid": only a payment of this past-due amount (a past payoff or closure is a dispute).
intents.restructure: A request for a new payment plan or lower instalments.
intents.vague: A vague period such as "next week", "end of the month", "when my salary comes".
intents.too_much: The customer says the full amount is too much.

lines.opening: Hello, this is the digital assistant of Freya Bank. We record this call.
lines.robot: Yes, I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.
lines.scam: You can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can only tell you that once I have confirmed I am speaking with the right person. The security questions protect your account.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I don't have that information.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand. This will only take a few minutes.
lines.tp_ask_time: At what time could I call back?
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, I can only call back today or on the next business day, between 10:00 and 19:00. Is there another time that would work?
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only speak with {title} {last_name}.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you. I will call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.condolence: I am sorry for your loss.
lines.id_intro: Before we go on, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_explain: I ask them to make sure I am speaking with the right person and to protect your account.
lines.id_declined: I understand. I cannot continue without these answers.
lines.id_repeat: Sorry, could you please say that again?
lines.id_wrong: I'm sorry, that does not match our records.
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I can't continue with this call. Please use the Freya Bank mobile app or visit a branch.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you. I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.
lines.product_line: Your {name} has {amount} past due, and it is {days} days late.
lines.ask_today: Can you make this payment today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you make these payments today?
lines.offer_floor_date: I understand. You could pay {amount} on {date}, and the rest stays overdue. Would that work for you?
lines.offer_floor: I understand. You could pay {amount}, and the rest stays overdue. Would that work for you?
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, I can't record an amount below {floor}. Could you pay {floor}?
lines.below_floor_again: I'm sorry, I can't accept that amount.
lines.date_past: That date has already passed. Could you choose today or a later day?
lines.not_business_day: That day is not a business day. The next business day is {date}. Would that work for you?
lines.after_deadline: The latest date I can record is {date}. Could you pay on {date}?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day would that be?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which day could you pay {amount}?
lines.repeat_offer: That would be {amount} on {date}. Would that work for you?
lines.readback_intro: Let me read that back to you.
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest date I can accept is {date}.
lines.recorded: Thank you, your promise is recorded.
lines.sms_line: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, I could not record your promise.
lines.paid_line: Thank you for letting me know. Payments can take one business day to appear.
lines.dispute_line: I understand. I won't ask you for a payment on this call.
lines.hardship: I'm very sorry to hear that. Would you like me to connect you with our customer support team?
lines.restructure_line: I will connect you with a colleague who can discuss that with you.
lines.human_ask_help: Is there anything I can help you with first?
lines.transfer: I am connecting you now. Please hold.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: You can change your promise in the Freya Bank mobile app.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
lines.callback_failed: I'm sorry, I could not book the callback.
lines.transfer_failed: I'm sorry, the transfer did not go through.
lines.confirm_again: Sorry, I did not catch that. Do you confirm, yes or no?
lines.system_error: I'm sorry, our system is not responding right now.
lines.below_floor_final: I'm sorry, I can't accept less than {amount}.

quotes: A flat refusal or a non-answer uses one persuasion attempt.
A no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal.
rules.opening_is_attempt.derivation: Refusing the first ask ('Can you make this payment today?') uses attempt 1, so the opening ask is not itself an attempt; the band attempts (1 and 2) are the proposals after it.

quotes: Do not repeat an offer the customer already refused.
If today is that day, propose the last business day of next week.
rules.opening_blocks_repeat.derivation: The general no-repeat rule is built in. Attempt 1 never falls on today because of the week-end rule, so the brief needs no explicit opening-repeat skip. Left false.

rules.too_much_skips_full.assumption: The brief does not say that later full-amount steps are skipped. Attempt 1 uses the floor via full_or_floor once the customer has said the full amount is too much.

quotes: If the customer says the full amount is too much, offer the floor, once.
Attempt 1 is for the full past-due amount, or for the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much.
rules.too_much_floor.derivation: After 'too much', the floor is offered as attempt 1 on attempt 1's date. Refusing it is a flat refusal, which leads to attempt 2 (floor on the deadline) in the late band.

quotes: When the attempts are used up, stop.
rules.ladder_repeat_last.derivation: No step is repeated beyond the band's attempts.

quotes: A flat refusal or a non-answer uses one persuasion attempt.
If the customer refuses the deadline, treat it as a flat refusal (rule 30).
If it fails, try once more.
Offer to connect them with the customer support team.

rules.deadline_adjust.derivation: Deadlines are counted in business days, so they are always business days. The brief gives no adjustment rule, so the engine default (previous_business_day) is kept.

quotes: Ask for the full past-due amount first.
First ask: "Can you make this payment today?".
If today is that day, propose the last business day of next week.

rules.skipped_repeat_counts.assumption: The brief does not say whether a skipped repeat step uses an attempt. The engine default applies.

products.floor_pct.assumption: The floor is an account field (minimum_payment / instalment_amount), not a percentage.

products.floor_full_below.assumption: No threshold below which the full debt is the floor.

products.floor_round.assumption: No rounding is stated. Floors are taken as given by get_account.

products.step_round.assumption: There are no percentage steps and no rounding is stated.

products.promise_scale.assumption: create_promise takes the same units as get_account.

multi.outcome_priority.assumption: Brief A covers one product. The default ending applies.

multi.order.assumption: Brief A covers one product. Account order is used.

event_changes.assumption: There are no dated code changes.

changes.assumption: There are no dated value changes.

assumptions: The brief names no currency. The default 'dollars' is used.
max_unclear is omitted: the brief does not say how often an unclear answer is asked again. Rule 30 makes a non-answer use a persuasion attempt (non_answer_counts true).

too_much_floor 'attempt_1': rule 30 says attempt 1 is for the floor once the customer has said the full amount is too much, and rule 26 makes refusing the floor a flat refusal that moves on to the next attempt.

Ladder: attempt 1 is the full amount, or the floor after 'too much', on the last business day of this week (next week's if today is that day). Attempt 2, late band only, is the floor on the deadline. The early band has 1 attempt.

Deadlines are the 12th (early) and 7th (late) business day after today, which excludes today. They are always business days. deadline_adjust keeps the default previous_business_day because the brief gives no rule.
Callback: today or the next business day, 10:00 to 19:00 inclusive, later than now. 'Today' is not restricted to business days because the brief does not say so.
Numeric dates of birth are read as day, month, year (rule 11). The verify tool receives YYYY-MM-DD.
Brief A never uses add_note: notes are disabled and every event note is empty.
The brief does not say whether to ask 'anything else' after a recorded promise. The default (true) is kept.
bands_outside is omitted: the brief only calls customers 1 to 45 days late. A product outside these bands takes the engine default (service_error).
transfer_human uses queue 'general' (rule 42). Restructuring and support use their own queues.
If a transfer follows a recorded promise, the call closes as transferred with that transfer's reason (built-in: a transfer ends the call).
Rule 32: a customer in hardship who still names a date or amount is handled under sections 7 and 8 by the engine's normal proposal handling.
The wording for the day_month_swapped hint (asking for the month as a word) follows rule 13. That retry is not counted as a wrong answer.
